hero.title: How It Works
hero.subtitle: From first conversation to lasting memories

step1.title: Initial Consultation
step1.description: We begin with a personal conversation to understand your travel aspirations, preferences, and any special requirements. Whether by phone, video call, or email — we listen carefully.

step2.title: Tailored Proposal
step2.description: Within 48 hours, you receive a detailed, bespoke itinerary crafted around your interests. We include accommodation recommendations, experience suggestions, and transparent pricing.

step3.title: Refine & Confirm
step3.description: We refine every detail together until the journey is exactly right. Once confirmed, we handle all bookings, logistics, and special arrangements on your behalf.

step4.title: Travel & Enjoy
step4.description: Your journey unfolds seamlessly with our 24/7 concierge support. On the ground, our local team ensures every moment exceeds expectations.

hero.title: Experiences
hero.subtitle: Immerse yourself in the real Asia

experiences.intro: Our experiences go beyond sightseeing. We connect you with the people, traditions, and flavors that make each destination extraordinary.

culinary.title: Culinary Journeys
culinary.description: From bustling night markets to private chef's tables, explore Asia's extraordinary food culture. Learn the art of dumpling-making with a local grandmother, visit tea plantations at dawn, or dine at Asia's finest Michelin-starred restaurants.

cultural.title: Cultural Discoveries
cultural.description: Step into living history through temple ceremonies, traditional arts workshops, and encounters with local artisans. From calligraphy masters to temple stays, these experiences offer profound connections to Asia's rich heritage.

walking.title: Walking & Nature
walking.description: Discover Asia's breathtaking landscapes on foot — from Taiwan's Taroko Gorge to Hong Kong's dramatic coastal trails. Our guided walks range from gentle heritage strolls to invigorating mountain treks.

localLife.title: Local Life
localLife.description: Experience daily life as locals do — visit morning markets with a chef, join a tai chi session in the park, explore artisan workshops, or share stories over tea with a local family. These authentic moments create the most treasured memories.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Asia Curated Travel was born from a simple conviction: that the most meaningful travel experiences come from genuine understanding — of a place, its people, and the traveler.
Founded by a team of Asia specialists with deep roots in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and China, we bridge the gap between Western travelers and the extraordinary richness of East Asia.
We are not a mass-market agency. We are a small consultancy of passionate individuals who personally know every hotel we recommend, every guide we engage, and every experience we suggest.

founder.name: Sophie Laurent
founder.description: With 18 years living between Paris and Taipei, Sophie brings an unmatched dual perspective to luxury Asian travel.

operations.name: James Chen
operations.description: Born in Hong Kong and educated in London, James ensures every logistical detail runs with precision.

china.name: Li Wei
china.description: A former historian turned travel designer, Li Wei reveals China's hidden stories to curious travelers.
